title: London Bridge at Lake Havasu has children walled up in it

tellings.quote: >> Knight of Columbus is the controlling interest and the reason they brought that bridge is because there's kids walled up in it

plain: London Bridge, the old bridge moved from England to Lake Havasu, Arizona, in the 1960s, is said to have children walled up inside it, and that this is why it was brought over. A guest named Kurt Metzger tells this, passing on what a man named Nathan Reynolds told him, and adds that the Knights of Columbus, a Catholic men's organization, hold the controlling interest. If true, it would make the bridge a hidden site of a dark crime.
